ratios.facility: Credit Agreement (Wells Fargo revolving credit facility)
ratios.quote: At September 30, 2026, our consolidated total leverage ratio under the Credit Agreement was 2.90 to 1.00 as compared to a covenant maximum of 3.50 to 1.00.

ratios.facility: Credit Agreement (Wells Fargo revolving credit facility)
ratios.quote: At September 30, 2026, our consolidated interest coverage ratio under the Credit Agreement was 3.40 to 1.00 as compared to a covenant minimum of 3.00 to 1.00.

parsed.notes: The Third Amendment (Feb 25, 2026) temporarily relaxed the covenants during the Covenant Adjustment Period: maximum leverage up to 5.25x and minimum interest coverage 2.75x. The company exited that period during Q3 2026, so the standard limits of 3.50x maximum leverage and 3.00x minimum interest coverage apply at 2026-09-30. The filing states compliance at 2025-12-31 but gives no ratio values for that date. The SOFR margin grid based on leverage is a pricing term, not a covenant, so it is excluded.
